screen_flag_dispositions.explanation: Printed 8 á 9000 abbreviates 8,000 to 9,000 on the inspected Toreno II p241 image. No change to source digits.
Treize mille spells thirteen thousand on Le Noble p41; ne comptaient pas establishes fewer than 13,000 bayonets, not total cavalry-inclusive strength.
The same retained Toreno II p336 image gives 5,000 left under Wimpffen in the preceding paragraph. They are a separate absent population, not added to Reding’s moving force.
20 March is the frozen engagement date used to distinguish the earlier approach, not a troop count claimed in this short Toreno quote.
Quarante mille spells 40,000; the inspected Le Noble p130 page dates Franceschi/Delaborde’s approach to the 17th. It is expressly not a matched 20 March return.
11 à 12,000 abbreviates 11,000 to 12,000 on Jourdan p186; whole assembled corps, not unsupported advance cavalry.
Vingt mille spells 20,000 on Le Noble p151; an approach army, not all engaged at the assault.
Soixante mille spells 60,000 on Le Noble p151; mixed growing gathering includes regulars/militia/armed inhabitants, not all combatants in the line.
Twenty-five spells 25 on Oman II p336. The 27,000 comparison is explicitly Bodart’s separate bodart-strength claim, not attributed to Oman’s landing passage.
Treize bataillons and moins de neuf mille spell 13 battalions and fewer than 9,000 on Suchet p27; initial subset before reinforcement, not an all-army total.
Vingt-deux bataillons spells 22 battalions on Suchet p34. Formation count is not converted to soldiers.
Quatre mille spells 4,000 on Suchet p34; opponent estimate of reinforcement, not Spanish whole-field strength.
3 à 4,000 abbreviates 3,000–4,000 on Jourdan p270; the preceding sentence dates assembly to the evening of 10 August. The whole page is retained and inspected.
25 à 30,000 abbreviates 25,000–30,000 on Jourdan p279; the same inspected paragraph dates delayed report arrival at Madrid to the 21st. It is explicitly reported, not a Spanish muster.
26 November is the frozen frame/Bodart date used for comparison. Jourdan p285 and Toreno III p165 explicitly give the 28th; no frame correction or invented reconciliation.
Trois mille spells 3,000 on Saint-Cyr p161. The comparison 5,673 is Toreno’s separate gerona-opening-garrison claim, not attributed to Saint-Cyr.
Dix-huit mille and douze mille spell 18,000 and 12,000 on Saint-Cyr p163. The same page dates Lechi’s transfer to 22 May, quoted in the command claim. Different allocations and times remain separate.
The preceding paragraph on the same retained Toreno III p117 image dates the 1,100 effectives to the 8th. It is not opening strength or all remaining prisoners.
10 December is the frozen frame endpoint, expressly separate from Toreno’s quoted 11 December entry. The short entry quote is not claimed to date the capitulation.
